# Part B: the Panel's `Strict-Transport-Security` header, read on the guest from the running Panel (generated by tools/summary.py)

Each cell is `status · header value(s)` exactly as the answer carried them; `(no such header)` means the answer has no `Strict-Transport-Security` line. HTTPS requests go to `https://127.0.0.1:2083` on the guest (certificate not verified; the leaf's SHA-256 is in the raw file); plain-HTTP requests are sent over a raw socket. "as owner" means the owner's session cookie was sent. The raw file of a column holds every answer with all its headers; the `.txt` beside it is the same as text.
